title: Φ identity; residual-(i) reduces to m4₂ ≤ n(n−2)/4 (OPEN)
open_hinge: OPEN: ‖m₄‖₂² ≤ n(n−2)/4 for all primes p≥5.  Equivalent forms: K₄ ≤ n(15n−22); ‖δ‖₂² ≤ (p−1)(p+1)(p²+1)(3p²−47)/(24(p²−5)).  Path-C residual δ²≤room_hyp/24 is sufficient (room_hyp/24 ≤ R-room for all primes p≥5: True) but itself OPEN.  Census: m4₂ ≤ target at p=5 (boolean evec enumeration).

hinge.note: 15.217 repairs Rayleigh gap: R≤2p is equivalent to m4₂≤n(n−2)/4 (via exact Φ).  That m4₂ bound remains OPEN.  Residual (i) OPEN.
